rules.review: Preserve a substantive exclusion or contrast; edit only an invented objection.
Keep every distinct item and its order; lists and required inventories stay intact.
Check rhetorical purpose; preserve chronological narrative and deliberate parallelism.
Review the dash function and the supplied author profile, not a punctuation quota.

rules.name_zh: 提示性冒号与空列表引导
rules.name_en: Prompt colons and empty list lead-ins
rules.review: Keep direct speech, explanatory hierarchy and substantive lead-in information.

patterns.pattern: (?:一句话总结|简单来说|核心是|关键在于|原因如下|总结|结论|换句话说)[：:]

rules.review: Only remove heading ordinals; retain cross-references, procedural numbering, wording and levels.
Use an already stated function; do not convert metaphorical praise into an invented capability.

rules.name_en: Ground a summary in existing detail
rules.review: Use only the matching existing quantity, object, unit and condition; add no evidence.

patterns.pattern: 显著提升|大幅增长|明显改善|效率的提升|大量|众多

rules.review: Delete only the cue; preserve the following claim and register.
Resolve syntactic burden without losing temporal, causal or scope relationships.

patterns.pattern: ^(?:然而|因此|此外|与此同时|换言之|总而言之)[，,]
^(?:这意味着|这表明|这说明|换句话说)

rules.review: Add a reference only when its antecedent is unambiguous; otherwise retain the original.
